existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 keeps the `Group` identity but changes the local model in breaking ways: mandatory R4 `actual` is replaced by mandatory `membership`, optional R4 `active` is removed, and R6 adds richer canonical and cohort-definition semantics. The largest migration concerns are membership-basis inference, lifecycle mapping, and lossy R6-to-R4 conversion for expanded types/targets and characteristic logic. The main uncertainty is the absence of an official Group cross-version ConceptMap or narrative diff.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Treat migration as a semantic transform, not a field rename. `actual=true/false` cannot be mapped to `membership` without understanding whether membership is enumerated, definitional, or conceptual. `active` needs a local policy for `status`. R6-to-R4 conversion should detect and either extension-preserve or reject new type codes, new member targets, canonical metadata, `valueExpression`/`valueUri`, non-`all-of` combination methods, and characteristic qualifiers such as `offset`, `duration[x]`, and `relativeTime`.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural deltas because both assigned StructureDefinitions were present and directly compared, and key terminology CodeSystems/ValueSets were inspected locally. Confidence is lower for intended migration mappings and justification because no official diff narrative, ballot rationale, terminology-server expansion, or cross-version ConceptMap was available.

rationaleMd:
Group keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 2 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 1, which creates weak stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 37/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Mandatory Group.actual boolean was replaced by mandatory Group.membership code
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 instance contains required `actual` and lacks required R6 `membership`; runtime/API/codegen and R6-to-R4 loss also arise because the old boolean and new three-code basis are not lossless equivalents.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Group.active was removed while R6 adds lifecycle status as an optional modifier element
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances that populate `active` contain an unknown R6 element unless transformed; R6-to-R4 loss exists for `draft`, `retired`, and `unknown` status nuances.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Group.code changed from member-kind example coding to extensible group-use coding
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: the strongest issue is changed meaning and stronger extensible terminology expectations, not universal old-valid/new-invalid rejection.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds modifier Group.combinationMethod for combining characteristics
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: R6 processors and generated models must not ignore the modifier; R6-to-R4 loss occurs for non-`all-of` methods, but there is no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 instance break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds several characteristic qualifier elements, including modifier offset
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: R6 evaluators must process or reject new qualifiers, especially modifier `offset`; R6-to-R4 loss occurs when any added qualifier is populated.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Group.member.entity accepts many new target resource types in R6
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: a new R6 member reference such as `Organization/example` is outside the R4 target profile set; no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 break is present.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Group.type is no longer always mandatory and the required group-type value set was expanded
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: conceptual Groups without `type` and Groups with new type codes cannot be represented in R4 without extensions or policy; there is no old-valid/new-invalid mechanism for R4 `Group.type` values.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Group now implements CanonicalResource-style metadata
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: metadata/tooling: generated R6 classes/interfaces and R6-to-R4 metadata handling change, but there is no old-valid/new-invalid instance break from the optional canonical fields.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Group.characteristic.value[x] adds uri and Expression choice types
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: `valueUri` and `valueExpression` are not R4 choice names; no old-valid/new-invalid concern exists for R4 choices.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Group.characteristic and key children became summary elements
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: REST `_summary` responses or generated summary models may include fields that R4-oriented clients did not expect; no old-valid/new-invalid or R6-to-R4 data loss mechanism is present.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
